problem_type: Connection affordance visibility gated on incidental conditions instead of one owner rule
symptom: User report 2026-09-21: the left/right '+' connection rings on canvas cards appear only sometimes. On a selected image card the ring vanished as soon as the pointer left the card; video, text, audio and other cards never showed a ring at all, only small dots.
direct_cause: The ring needed four conditions at once: (1) selected, (2) sole selection, (3) kind is image/asset/image-like in resolveGenerationFlowConnectionAffordance, and (4) pointer hovering the card, because generationCanvasReactFlow.css kept the magnetic icon at opacity 0 unless .node-shell:hover / :focus-within / data-active / data-following.
class_root: Who gets which connection affordance was decided in two places with two different vocabularies: a kind allow-list inside the owner function and a hover gate in CSS carried over from the pre-React-Flow design. Three node renderers (BaseGenerationNode, ClipNode, DirectorNode) also still mounted their own legacy MagneticConnectionHandle copies that CSS hid with display:none inside the React Flow shell, so there were parallel handle implementations and the visible behaviour depended on which one a reader looked at.
affected_population: Every canvas user trying to start a connection from a selected card whose pointer is not over it, and every user of non-image cards (video, text, audio, 3D, panorama, director, clip, whiteboard, shot table, agent artifact...)
entry_points: React Flow source handles on every canvas card (GenerationFlowConnectionHandle)
Collapsed group card handles (CollapsedGroupCard, projection layer)

external_sources.purpose: React Flow renders one Handle per id per node; connectability is a node/handle property (isConnectableStart), so 'can start a connection' is derivable from the kernel and needs no kind list.
Prior art consulted for the companion Alt-drag change (clone on first move while Alt is held).

invariants: Which connection affordance a card shows is decided only by resolveGenerationFlowConnectionAffordance: collapsed-group proxy -> hidden; not the sole primary selection or it is the in-progress connection source -> dot; otherwise -> magnetic. No kind allow-list. The collapsed-group proxy is hidden because its projection-layer card renders the handle; that card is not a React Flow node.
A magnetic ring is visible without hover (opacity 0.82 at rest, accent when hovered/active/following).
Only the sole selected card owns magnetic bands, so edges passing next to unselected cards stay clickable.
A selected card's own surface (version pill, version tray) sits above its magnetic bands.
There is one card connection handle implementation inside the React Flow shell; node renderers mount none.

door_reduction.why_not: Before: owner function + its reader + the flow CSS + four MagneticConnectionHandle mounts (BaseGenerationNode, ClipNode, DirectorNode, CollapsedGroupCard) + the legacy handle CSS. The three node-renderer mounts are deleted. CollapsedGroupCard keeps its own handle (and the legacy magnetic CSS it uses): it renders in the projection layer outside any React Flow node, so it cannot mount a React Flow Handle, and it has no selection state (clicking it does not select members), so the sole-selection rule has no input there. Left as a documented exception for the user to decide.

generality_proof: The owner no longer reads node.kind at all; the unit test enumerates GENERATION_NODE_KINDS so any newly registered kind is covered automatically, and the real-app walkthrough selects one card of every kind and asserts the ring after moving the pointer off the card.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Single decision of hidden / dot / magnetic for every card.
Magnetic ring is visible at rest; no hover gate.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: Only rendered outside the React Flow shell (devlab) or hidden by display:none inside it; deleted with its hide rule and legacy CSS.
Hidden by display:none inside the React Flow shell; deleted.
Hidden by display:none inside the React Flow shell; deleted.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: MagneticConnectionHandle on the collapsed group card
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Projection-layer card without selection state; bands always present, '+' revealed on hover as before. Reported as an open product question instead of guessing a selection model.

recurrence.reason: Every card kind other than image-like and every hover-off moment hid the entry; any new node kind would have been silently excluded by the allow-list.
same_class_scan: node scripts/door-map.mjs MagneticConnectionHandle: 1 door after removal (4 before)
rg 'generation-canvas-v2-node__handle|generation-canvas-v2-node__magnetic-handle' src tests: legacy selectors updated in two walkthroughs

prevention.invariant: Affordance derives from selection and connection state only, never from kind or hover.
prevention.failure_mode: Re-adding a kind condition turns the per-kind GENERATION_NODE_KINDS unit test red (positive control done: image-only rule -> 15 failures); re-adding a node-renderer handle turns canvasControlsStructure.test.ts red.
prevention.strategy: Delete the kind allow-list and the CSS hover gate, delete the legacy in-card handle copies, raise the selected card surface above its own bands.

legacy_paths.rationale: In-card handle copies, their display:none hide rule and the .generation-canvas-v2-node__handle CSS are deleted in the same change.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: No dependency change; @xyflow/react 12.11.5 Handle is already the single implementation.

residual_risks: Collapsed group cards still show always-on bands with a hover-revealed '+' (no selection state to gate on); open question for the user.
Bands of the selected card can cover neighbouring cards' edges within 112 px of that one card, as in the pre-migration design.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 「谁有什么把手」只在这一个函数里判；测试按 GENERATION_NODE_KINDS 全表逐种断言，阳性对照：改回只给图片类即 15 条红。
